# Draft:D.A.V. Sarada Eashwar Vidyalaya

----
DAV Sarada Eashwar Vidyalaya is a co-educational, CBSE-affiliated school located in Pozhichalur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The school offers education from pre-kindergarten to Class XII and is managed by the DAV Group of Schools, Chennai.
History
The school was established in 1998 as Sri Sarada Eshwar Vidya Mandir Matriculation Higher Secondary School by P. E. Subramaniam, a philanthropist and Managing Trustee of the PES Charitable Trust, with the blessings of His Holiness Poojyasri Sankaracharya Swamigal of Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam. The institution was rebranded as DAV Sarada Eashwar Vidyalaya in October 2022 after entering into a management partnership with the DAV Group of Schools, Chennai.
Campus
The school is situated on a 4,634 square meter campus in Pozhichalur, Chennai. The school operates from 08:00 AM to 02:40 PM, with office hours from 08:00 AM to 03:30 PM.
Academics
The school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and offers classes from pre-kindergarten to Class XII. At the senior secondary level, students can choose between Science and Commerce streams, with subject options including Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Computer Science, Economics, Business Studies, and Accountancy.
Houses
Subash Chandra Bose, Velu Nachiyar, Bhagat Singh, Sardar Patel
Management
The school is managed by the Tamil Nadu Arya Samaj Educational Society (TNAES) and is part of the DAV Group of Schools, Chennai, which operates multiple institutions across the city and state.
Leadership
* Principal: M. Sathish Kumar (as of 2025), who holds M.Sc., M.Phil., PGDCA, PGDEdL, and B.Ed. degrees.
* Founder: P. E. Subramaniam, Managing Trustee of PES Charitable Trust.
Affiliations and Network
The school is part of the DAV Group of Schools, Chennai, which includes several other prominent schools such as DAV Girls, Gopalapuram; DAV Boys, Gopalapuram; DAV Girls, Mogappair; DAV Boys, Mogappair; and DAV Matriculation, Gill Nagar.
